details: Definition. The singleton family strengthens the former finite three-code witness: proper stable unlabeled compression is $\Theta(n)$ while stable unlabeled compression is one for $n\ge2$.
witness_verification: Value #values/proper_stable_sample_compression_singletons gives $\mathrm{psUSC}\ge\lceil(n-1)/2\rceil$ and an actual finite stable scheme; the established singleton sUSC value is one. Their ratio diverges.
proof: Proper stable unlabeled compression adds properness to stable unlabeled compression. Restricting the allowed reconstruction functions cannot decrease the minimum size.
name: Proper Stable Sample Compression / Stable Unlabeled Complexity
